content: IndexedDB eviction: Safari proactively deletes script-writable storage after 7 days without user interaction in browser tab (ITP). Home-screen installed PWAs have separate interaction counter and are largely exempt. navigator.storage.persist() upgrades to persistent mode (heuristic grant, no prompt on Safari). Call after engagement, not first load; handle denial with export backup UX. persist() helps but isn't 100% on Safari—install + backup remain safety nets.
